import csv

# Key series ids
# F2_Z01 occupied cooling setpoint
f2z01_occ_cool_sp = "c5120bcb-e5c2-5714-a171-cbdb1f8ef5ab"
# F2_Z01 cooling setpoint (main)
f2z01_cool_sp = "1213f3a8-c23d-55b5-8187-4712d49a82ae"
# F2_Z01 air temperature
f2z01_temp = "baef86cb-2941-5d61-87b0-ffa91d79f23a"

# Load values for these series
def load_series(sid):
    rows=[]
    for r in csv.DictReader(open(VALUES_CSV)):
        if r['timeseries_id']==sid:
            rows.append((r['timestamp'],float(r['value'])))
    rows.sort()
    return rows

occ_sp = load_series(f2z01_occ_cool_sp)
cool_sp = load_series(f2z01_cool_sp)
temp = load_series(f2z01_temp)

def avg_before_after(data, cutoff="2018-06-15"):
    before=[v for ts,v in data if ts < cutoff]
    after=[v for ts,v in data if ts >= cutoff]
    b=sum(before)/len(before) if before else None
    a=sum(after)/len(after) if after else None
    return b,a,len(before),len(after)

print("Occupied cooling setpoint F2_Z01:")
b,a,nb,na = avg_before_after(occ_sp)
print(f"  before: {b:.3f} (n={nb}), after: {a:.3f} (n={na}), delta: {a-b if a and b else None}")

print("Cooling setpoint (main) F2_Z01:")
b,a,nb,na = avg_before_after(cool_sp)
print(f"  before: {b:.3f} (n={nb}), after: {a:.3f} (n={na}), delta: {a-b if a and b else None}")

print("Air temp F2_Z01:")
b,a,nb,na = avg_before_after(temp)
print(f"  before: {b:.3f} (n={nb}), after: {a:.3f} (n={na}), delta: {a-b if a and b else None}")
